plainTranslation: Affection that flows effortlessly. The Sun person feels valued, the Venus person feels at ease - smooth, harmonious, kind. Failure mode: lacking tension or challenge. A warm foundation; keep it from getting sleepy.
humanMoment: {{holder1}} feels appreciated and {{holder2}} feels completely at ease, with zero effort required from either side.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryShort: Your identity and their affection cooperate, so liking each other comes easily.
summaryDeep: Your identity and their affection cooperate, so liking each other comes easily. A natural, pleasant warmth. Let the ease be part of the foundation.
tension: The risk is the usual one with easy contacts: because the warmth comes naturally, neither person may think to deepen it or take care of it. A connection this pleasant can drift on autopilot.
advice: Enjoy the ease, but keep offering something real. Pleasant is a gift, not a substitute for effort.
